stories.title: October home sales down 10.6% from a year ago, but edge up from September: CREA
stories.summary: OTTAWA — The Canadian Real Estate Association says October home sales crept up slightly from September but were still down more than 10 per cent from a year ago. The organization says home sales last month totalled 37,827, down 10.
